sloka: दृष्ट्वा कन्दर्प वशगो मुनिः ताम् इदम् अब्रवीत् ।अप्सरः स्वागतम् ते अस्तु वस च इह मम आश्रमे ॥१-६३-६॥
transliteration: dṛṣṭvā kandarpa vaśago muniḥ tām idam abravīt ।apsaraḥ svāgatam te astu vasa ca iha mama āśrame ॥1-63-6॥

translations.english: On seeing her (Menaka) Viswamitra came under the influence of the god of love (fell in love with her). He said, O Apsara welcome to my hermitage stay here. I am infatuated with you: Oblige me. Wish you well.
